artifact_observations.reasoning: The red characters appear to be an attempt at text or a logo but are malformed and illegible, typical of AI generation struggling with typography.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The edges of the yellow shape bleed slightly into the white background, and the internal details lack the crispness of a real decal or laser engraving.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a lighter and not a similar rectangular object like a power bank or case.
To verify the physical continuity of the metal shell and check for melting artifacts at the lid hinge.

focus_areas: Legibility and coherence of the red text/logo
Sharpness of the boundary between the printed graphic and the white casing

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'text_gibberish' artifact. In AI images, logos often look plausible at a glance but fail under scrutiny. Verify if the red shapes are actual letters or just abstract blobs mimicking text. Also, check if the spark wheel is physically connected to the body or floating.
